title: The Outer Worlds 2 PS5 DLC Split into Two Parts, First in December
summary:
Ask your doctor about DLC.

Obsidian still wants to carry out its post-launch DLC plans for The Outer Worlds 2, having lost 25% of its workforce in a recent round of layoffs. It's today announced an expansion called Side Effect Guaranteed will release in two parts: the first launches for PS5 on 2nd December 2026, and then the second arrives in Spring 2027. See it in action in the trailer.

The new DLC takes place just before the end of the main game, so if you've already finished a playthrough, there'll be a new option on the starting menu screen that lets you access the content through a new character.

In an interview with 3DMGAME, chief producer Kazuhisa Wada shared the original plan was to launch the remake "as early as possible — we originally planned to release it about six months earlier, which would have been just in time for summer, but we ultimately couldn't make it that way".

title: GTA 6 Pre-Orders Outperform Even Take-Two's Expectations, GTA 5 Just Keeps on Selling
summary:
GTA 5 now at 235 million sales.

We won't know how well GTA 6 is selling during its pre-order phase until after the game's launch next week, but with the biggest entertainment release of all time projected and now Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick talking up the numbers, we could be looking at some absurd sales stats.

Speaking alongside the publication of financial reports, Zelnick said GTA 6 pre-orders are "running far in excess of our expectations". The game has been available to pre-order 25th June 2026, so they'll have been available for almost five months when GTA 6 finally comes out on 19th November. That's a long time to build up millions of pre-orders.
